puzzles.title: Book Cipher
puzzles.description: Decode the hidden message using the book cipher method.
hints: Check the first letter of each word
Look at the index numbers in the margin

puzzles.title: Gemstone Pattern
puzzles.description: Arrange the gemstones in the correct order.
hints: Notice the pictures of the wall carvings

puzzles.title: Ghost Riddle
puzzles.description: Solve the riddle whispered by the ghost.
hints: Think about what can be heard but has no sound

puzzles.title: The Safe Code Note
puzzles.description: A note on the safe says: Add 10 and 5, multiply by 2, subtract 1, then repeat the last two digits twice.
hints: Do the math step by step.
Focus on the final two digits.
